newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SASOL IN MOZAMBIQUE OIL AND GAS ALLIANCE.
newsitem.headline: SASOL IN MOZAMBIQUE OIL AND GAS ALLIANCE.

text.p: Sasol Petroleum International, a division of Sasol Ltd, said on Tuesday it had formed an alliance with Atlantic Richfield's Arco International Oil and Gas Co Ltd and Zarara Petroleum Resources to explore for oil and gas in Mozambique.

Under the deal, SPI will acquire an interest of 47.62 percent in three additional blocks in Mozambique -- Temane, Sofala and M10 which are jointly held under a technical evaluation agreement between Arco and Zarara.
Arco and Zarara will have participation interests of 47.62 percent 4.76 percent respectively.
The Sasol unit already has an interest in the Mazenga block in southern Mozambique under a memorandum of understanding with the state oil company.
The new agreement provides for Arco to be the operator in all these blocks, with SPI taking over three to six years after first sale of commercial gas or oil.
